_about: Labels for the browser-diagnose message in inject-browser-refs.js. Key: the first 8 hex digits of the Claude account id in the Claude app log (acct:<id>, and Connecting to bridge .../chrome/<id>). account = the Claude account's email; profile = the browser profile whose Claude extension is signed in to it. Since 2026-10-25 the browser is Google Chrome (Comet 155 refuses the extension's clicks, screenshots and scripts). Evidence, 2026-10-25: with the app on c68119fc, the extension in Chrome profile 'info@muuula.com' (Chrome's Profile 4) connected and clicked; Erez signed the extension in Chrome profile 'Erez Work' (Default) in to erez@muuula.com (a47791bc). Labels go stale if Erez signs an extension in to a different account; to re-check, compare the log's account id at a successful pairing with the account each profile's Claude extension shows.
